padded.why: gambeson/quilted: absorbs blunt shock, edges cut it, points go through

leather.why: hardened leather: decent vs cuts and clubs, thin against thrusts

hide.why: thick hide/fur: like padding with a bit more cut resistance

studded.why: leather with rivets/plates: better against cuts, little vs thrust

mail.why: riveted rings stop a slash cold; a point splits rings, maces transmit shock

scale.why: overlapping scales: good all round, thrust can lift a scale

lamellar.why: laced plates, rigid: thrust-resistant, laces weak vs cuts

brigandine.why: plates riveted inside cloth: solid vs thrust, moderate elsewhere

cuirass.why: solid breastplate: edges glance off, points deflected, blunt transmits

plate.why: articulated plate: nearly cut-proof, thrust-resistant, blunt is its weakness

cloth.why: robes/mantles: no real protection; enchanted cloth is the mage default

bone.why: bone/chitin/shell plates: hard shell vs edge and point, brittle under blows

wood.why: wooden shields and laminates: good vs cuts and clubs, splits under thrust

shield_round.why: round shield: catches blows all round

shield_tower.why: tall shield: a wall against thrusts, heavy blows push it aside

shield_buckler.why: small buckler: parries edges, too small to catch heavy blows or long points

guard.why: bracers, vambraces, pauldrons: a small rigid plate turns an edge, a mace goes through

jewelry.why: rings, amulets, bracelets: flat, AC on these is magical only
